split.method: SHA256(seed:feature_vector), identical retained feature vectors stay together

preprocess: train-only median imputation; logistic uses log1p then train-only standard scaling; rule thresholds are predeclared
calibration: per-model sigmoid on logit(raw_score), fitted on calibration split only; rule raw score is fraction of four triggered conditions, not a probability
model_selection: highest validation average precision of calibrated scores, lexicographic model ID tie-break
threshold_selection: per model maximize validation recall under FPR <= 0.02; ties maximize precision then higher threshold; no-positive option allowed
capacity: floor(N * share); stable descending score, feature group then row ID tie-break; hypothetical review queue, not measured benefit
test_policy: one final read after frozen development output; exclusive access ledger; interactive test thresholds are retrospective scenarios, never new validation
limitations: 1999 historical email collection, no chronological or sender identifiers
exact feature groups kept together; near-duplicate emails cannot be ruled out
57 extracted attributes only; no original subjects or email bodies
four known collection-specific indicators excluded; residual collection bias remains
benchmark class mix is not a deployment prevalence estimate
